name: Anzen USDz
oneLiner: USDz is Anzen's RWA dollar backed 1:1 by SPCT, a permissioned token representing a diversified portfolio of U.S. private-credit assets.
collateral: Diversified U.S. private-credit assets tokenized as permissioned Secured Private Credit Tokens (SPCT), with USDz backed 1:1 by SPCT
pegMechanism: USDz is minted and redeemed 1:1 against SPCT through audited smart contracts; secondary-market arbitrage supports the dollar peg

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDz is a private-credit-backed RWA dollar with permissioned QMM mint/redeem mechanics; Anzen Group Ltd explicitly blocks US persons (prohibited jurisdiction in ToS) and holds no regulatory authorization in any jurisdiction, making GENIUS payment-stablecoin applicability unresolved.

genius.notes: USDz is stablecoin-adjacent but backed by private credit; GENIUS payment-stablecoin applicability is unresolved. reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
reserveReview.rationale: Anzen states that each USDz is backed 1:1 by SPCT and identifies SPCT as the permissioned on-chain representation of its U.S. private-credit ABS portfolio. Public-RPC totalSupply reads on 2026-07-20 returned SPCT pool (0xf30a29f1c540724fd8c5c4be1af604a6c6800d29) totalSupply 8,225,104.2033 against aggregate USDz totalSupply of 8,120,206.6146 across Ethereum (811,082.23), Base (6,690,509.36), Arbitrum (77,436.72), Blast (41,012.52), and Manta (500,165.78) — both figures unchanged from the 2026-07-14 readings, keeping SPCT coverage near 101.3% of USDz supply and confirming the single-asset reserve path without any USTB or other dependency. The 100% SPCT slice is unchanged; underlying loan-level weights are not published beyond Anzen's documented criteria (U.S.-based assets, ABS-only structures, single-asset concentration limits). Liquidity horizon is marked over-seven-days because SPCT is permissioned (KYC/KYB whitelist) and represents private credit, so reserve-level liquidation runs at loan/redemption timelines rather than public-market ones.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Anzen issuer disclosure corroborated by SPCT and multichain USDz totalSupply reads (public RPC, 2026-07-20)
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: SPCT is fully identified as the direct reserve asset; its underlying private-credit loan-level weights are not a tracked-stablecoin dependency question and are not published by the issuer.

sources.label: Anzen Terms of Service (Anzen Group Ltd, BVI; no regulatory registration)

custodyProfile.uncertainty: SPCT is a permissioned token (KYC/KYB-whitelisted holders) whose pool contract on Ethereum (0xf30a29f1c540724fd8c5c4be1af604a6c6800d29) anchors the on-chain reserve; the off-chain custody chain for the underlying U.S. private-credit ABS notes — custodian, trustee, servicer, and account segregation — is not disclosed in Anzen docs reviewed 2026-07-20. Anzen's collateral documentation explicitly disclaims any holder claim: information about the collateral 'does not create any relationship between USDz and the collateral or claims for USDz holders to the collateral assets', so no bankruptcy-remoteness structure for USDz holders is documented (marked none rather than unknown on that explicit disclaimer). Anzen Group Ltd (BVI) states in its Terms of Service that it is not registered with any regulatory body in any jurisdiction. Whether SPCT or the underlying collateral is rehypothecated or re-deployed is not addressed in issuer documentation (marked unknown). Loan-level composition, obligor identities, and weightings are not published; the legacy transparency host rwa.anzen.finance did not resolve during this review, while app.anzen.finance/transparency remains the live dashboard referenced by the proof-of-reserves record.

mintAuthority.summary: USDz uses immutable bytecode on all five tracked deployments, but its control plane is chain-local. Ethereum deposit minting is SPCT-gated under a 2/6 admin Safe; Base's 2/7 owner Safe controls OFT peers; and 2/6 Arbitrum, 2/7 Blast, and 2/6 Manta owner Safes can replace each chain's currently uncapped direct minter.

controls.label: Anzen DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe (upgrade/role authority)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295203, owner() on USDz token returned 0xc88729a8…; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN, 0xc88729a8…) = true; getOwners() returned 6 addresses; getThreshold() = 2; masterCopy slot0 = 0xd9db270c1b5e3bd161e8c8503c55ceabee709552 (Safe v1.3); guard storage slot = 0x0; getModulesPaginated returned empty array (count 0).

controls.label: SPCT deposit mint (user-callable, SPCT-gated)
controls.capDescription: deposit() and depositBySPCT() are callable by any holder of the permissioned SPCT token; mint supply is bounded by SPCT availability (issuer-controlled RWA).
controls.evidence: Blockscout ABI shows deposit(uint256) and depositBySPCT(uint256) on the USDz contract with no role guard visible in the ABI — supply expansion is bounded by SPCT access, which is issuer-controlled.

review.evidence: The five USDz deployments retain immutable runtime bytecode, but the complete authority graph is multichain. Ethereum uses its 2/6 DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe and SPCT-gated deposit path. At pinned Base 48626678, Arbitrum 483807177, Blast 37616444, and Manta 8981874 blocks, owner() resolved respectively to 2/7, 2/6, 2/7, and 2/6 chain-local Safes with no enabled modules or guard. Base's owner controls LayerZero peers. Arbitrum, Blast, and Manta owners can grant or revoke mint roles immediately; their sole current minters were 0xdd216101D84d513A12CB7bFB109F7abCF330D58e, 0x5A1b8C0e9fE27b9DB4913df6B361deA5e96EA129, and 0x04D5ddf5f3a8939889F11E97f8c4BB48317F1938, and each token returned maxSupply() = 0. No tracked child-chain control is omitted.
